subject.title: [Bug]: Unequal backtick delimiters bypass assistant reasoning-tag sanitization

question: Which single implementation should own the unequal-backtick fix before the duplicate candidate PR is closed?
rationale: Both open pull requests claim the same issue, but they describe materially different parser strategies; choosing the durable shared parsing contract requires maintainer judgment after branch-level review.

options.title: Review the comprehensive parser candidate
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/113168 as the likely canonical path because it describes maximal-run pairing, resumption behavior, and broader consumer coverage.

options.title: Adopt the smaller candidate
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/113206 only if its post-match length check is proven equivalent for nested and resumed inline-code scanning.

options.title: Request a narrowed replacement
options.body: Close neither candidate yet and request one focused shared-parser PR if neither branch preserves the intended code-region contract.

recommendation.title: Review the comprehensive parser candidate
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/113168 as the likely canonical path because it describes maximal-run pairing, resumption behavior, and broader consumer coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is assigned to steipete and the timeline records a recent related commit reference from that account.
